leaves.leaf: Atomic vectors, type coercion and missing values
leaves.scope: Base R's atomic vector types (logical, integer, double, complex, character, raw), typeof/mode/storage.mode, the coercion hierarchy, NA variants, NaN/Inf, integer limits and floating-point comparison.
queries: typeof mode storage.mode atomic vector types
as.integer coercion NAs introduced by coercion

leaves.leaf: Data frames, tibbles, attributes and factors
leaves.scope: The data.frame and tibble classes, core attributes (names, dim, row.names, class), stringsAsFactors behavior, and factor/levels handling including the forcats package.
queries: tibble print width partial matching tbl_df

leaves.leaf: Subsetting operators and replacement functions
leaves.scope: Semantics of [, [[, $, @ and subset(), the drop and exact arguments, negative/logical/character/matrix indexing, out-of-bounds behavior and replacement functions such as names<-.
queries: Extract operator drop exact partial matching
double bracket dollar subsetting lists recursive
matrix indexing negative indices out of bounds NA

leaves.leaf: Functions, environments, scoping and lazy evaluation
leaves.scope: Closures, formals/body/environment, lexical scoping, the search path and environment functions, promises and lazy evaluation, force, on.exit and the ... mechanism.
queries: closure formals body environment lexical scoping
search path globalenv emptyenv parent.frame sys.call

leaves.leaf: Metaprogramming, non-standard evaluation and tidy evaluation
leaves.scope: Language objects (calls, symbols, expressions), quote/substitute/bquote/eval/deparse, and rlang's quosures, injection operators, embracing and data masking.
queries: substitute quote bquote eval deparse expression
rlang quosure enquo injection operator splice
data masking embracing operator tidy evaluation

leaves.leaf: S3 classes, generics and the S7 object system
leaves.scope: S3 class attributes, UseMethod/NextMethod dispatch, group generics (Ops, Math, Summary), method registration, inherits/unclass, and the newer S7 object system package.
queries: group generic Ops Math Summary S3
S7 new_class new_generic method object system

leaves.leaf: S4 classes and the methods package
leaves.scope: setClass, slots, prototypes, validity methods, setGeneric/setMethod, multiple dispatch, virtual classes and class unions, show methods and S4 conventions used in Bioconductor.
queries: methods package isVirtualClass slotNames new initialize

leaves.leaf: Reference Classes and R6 encapsulated OOP
leaves.scope: Mutable encapsulated object systems in R: methods::setRefClass Reference Classes and the R6 package (public/private members, active bindings, inheritance, cloning, finalizers).

leaves.leaf: Condition handling: errors, warnings, messages and restarts
leaves.scope: stop/warning/message/signalCondition, try, tryCatch, withCallingHandlers, finally, restarts (invokeRestart, muffleWarning), custom condition classes, options(warn) and the rlang/cli error helpers.
queries: rlang abort cli_abort error call trace

leaves.leaf: R language release history and NEWS (R 3.x to 4.x)
leaves.scope: Version-by-version user-visible changes to base R recorded in NEWS, such as the native pipe |>, the \(x) lambda shorthand, raw strings, the stringsAsFactors default change, deprecations, and release nicknames and dates.
queries: R 4.1.0 native pipe operator lambda syntax
R 4.0.0 stringsAsFactors FALSE raw strings NEWS
R release nickname version date NEWS
R 4.4.0 NEWS new features deprecated defunct

leaves.leaf: R internals: memory management, ALTREP and the byte-code compiler
leaves.scope: SEXP object representation, copy-on-modify and reference counting, garbage collection, memory limits, long vectors, ALTREP compact and deferred representations, and the compiler package and JIT.
queries: R Internals SEXPTYPE header NAMED reference counting
compiler package cmpfun enableJIT byte code
gc garbage collector long vectors memory.limit

leaves.leaf: Native code interfaces: C API, .Call, Rcpp and cpp11
leaves.scope: Native interfaces from Writing R Extensions (.C, .Call, .External, PROTECT, R_registerRoutines, Makevars) and the C++ bridges Rcpp, RcppArmadillo, RcppEigen and cpp11.

leaves.leaf: Package structure, R CMD check and CRAN policies
leaves.scope: DESCRIPTION fields, NAMESPACE directives, package directory layout, R CMD build/check/INSTALL behavior, and the CRAN Repository Policy, submission process, task views and archiving.
queries: DESCRIPTION file Imports Depends Suggests LinkingTo
R CMD check as-cran NOTE WARNING
CRAN Repository Policy submission archived package

leaves.leaf: Package development tooling and documentation: devtools, usethis, roxygen2, pkgdown
leaves.scope: r-lib developer tools and documentation formats: devtools/usethis workflows, roxygen2 tags, Rd markup, vignettes and pkgdown websites.
queries: Rd file markup usage arguments examples sections

leaves.leaf: Unit testing and code coverage
leaves.scope: testthat (editions, expectations, snapshot tests, fixtures, skips), tinytest, RUnit, and covr coverage reporting for R packages.

leaves.leaf: dplyr and tidyr data wrangling
leaves.scope: dplyr verbs (filter, mutate, summarise, joins, across, .by) and tidyr reshaping and nesting (pivot_longer/pivot_wider, nest, separate_*), including lifecycle changes across versions.
queries: tidyr nest unnest separate_wider_delim gather spread

leaves.leaf: data.table syntax and performance
leaves.scope: data.table's DT[i, j, by] syntax, := assignment, the .SD/.N/.I special symbols, keys and joins, fread/fwrite, reshaping, and version-specific behavior.

leaves.leaf: ggplot2 grammar of graphics
leaves.scope: ggplot2 layers, geoms, stats, aesthetics, scales, coordinate systems, facets, themes and the ggproto extension API, plus changes between versions.

leaves.leaf: Base graphics, grid, lattice and graphics devices
leaves.scope: Base plotting (plot, par, layout), grDevices output devices and Cairo types, colour palettes, the grid viewport/grob system and lattice trellis graphics.
queries: par mfrow mar cex graphical parameters

leaves.leaf: Shiny and interactive web visualization
leaves.scope: Shiny reactive programming (reactives, observers, render functions, modules, bslib layouts), app deployment, and htmlwidgets-based interactive packages such as plotly, leaflet and DT.
queries: shiny reactive observeEvent renderPlot input output

leaves.leaf: Literate programming and reporting: knitr, R Markdown, Sweave and Quarto
leaves.scope: Dynamic documents in R: Sweave, knitr chunk options and engines, R Markdown output formats via pandoc, bookdown/blogdown, and Quarto.
queries: knitr chunk options echo eval fig.width

leaves.leaf: String manipulation, regular expressions and encodings
leaves.scope: Base string functions (paste, sprintf, substr, gsub, regmatches), the regex engines (TRE, PCRE via perl=TRUE, fixed), stringr/stringi (ICU), and character encodings (UTF-8, Encoding, iconv).
queries: gsub regexpr regmatches perl fixed TRE

leaves.leaf: Dates, times and time zones
leaves.scope: The Date, POSIXct, POSIXlt and difftime classes, strptime/format conversion codes, time zone handling, and the lubridate, hms and clock packages.

leaves.leaf: Data import, export and serialization formats
leaves.scope: Reading and writing data in R: read.table/read.csv, readr/vroom, readxl/writexl, haven/foreign for SAS, SPSS and Stata, arrow/feather/parquet, connections, and saveRDS/serialize formats.

leaves.leaf: Database connectivity: DBI, dbplyr and backends
leaves.scope: DBI generics (dbConnect, dbGetQuery, dbWriteTable), backend packages (RSQLite, RPostgres, odbc, duckdb, bigrquery) and dbplyr's translation of dplyr code to SQL.

leaves.leaf: Functional programming, iteration and pipes
leaves.scope: The apply family (lapply, sapply, vapply, mapply, rapply, tapply), Map/Reduce/Filter/Position, do.call and Vectorize, purrr map variants, and the magrittr pipe operators.
queries: purrr map_dbl map2 pmap imap list_rbind
magrittr pipe operator assignment tee exposition

leaves.leaf: Parallel and distributed computing
leaves.scope: The parallel package (mclapply, parLapply, makeCluster, L'Ecuyer RNG streams), snow, foreach/doParallel, future/furrr, mirai and BiocParallel.

leaves.leaf: Model formulas and regression fitting
leaves.scope: The formula language (~, :, *, ^, I(), offset), model.frame/model.matrix, contrasts, lm/glm/nls/anova/predict in stats, and formula-based mixed, additive and survival models in lme4, nlme, mgcv and survival.
queries: lm glm family link formula model.matrix
lme4 lmer glmer random effects formula
survival coxph Surv survfit mgcv gam

leaves.leaf: Probability distributions and random number generation
leaves.scope: The d/p/q/r distribution functions and their parameterizations, set.seed and RNGkind (Mersenne-Twister, L'Ecuyer-CMRG, the sample.kind change), normal.kind, and sample().
queries: dnorm pnorm qnorm rnorm lower.tail log.p
rbinom rgamma shape rate scale parameterization

leaves.leaf: Matrices, arrays and linear algebra
leaves.scope: Building and operating on matrices and arrays (%*%, crossprod, outer, aperm), solve/qr/chol/svd/eigen, BLAS/LAPACK configuration, and the Matrix package's dense and sparse classes.
queries: matrix crossprod solve qr chol svd
array aperm outer apply dim dimnames

leaves.leaf: Time series classes and forecasting packages
leaves.scope: Base ts objects (frequency, window, lag, arima, stl), zoo/xts indexed series, the forecast package, and the tidyverts packages (tsibble, fable, feasts).
queries: ts frequency start window stats arima

leaves.leaf: Spatial data analysis packages
leaves.scope: Vector and raster geospatial packages (sf, sp, terra, raster, stars), their links to GDAL/PROJ/GEOS/s2, and the 2023 retirement of rgdal, rgeos and maptools.
queries: rgdal rgeos maptools retirement 2023 sp evolution
GDAL PROJ GEOS s2 spherical geometry sf_use_s2

leaves.leaf: Bioconductor project and core infrastructure
leaves.scope: Bioconductor's release cycle and BiocManager, core classes (SummarizedExperiment, GenomicRanges, IRanges, Biostrings, ExpressionSet), and flagship analysis packages such as DESeq2, edgeR and limma.

leaves.leaf: Machine learning frameworks
leaves.scope: R machine learning ecosystems and algorithm packages: tidymodels (parsnip, recipes, rsample, tune, workflows), caret, mlr3, glmnet, randomForest/ranger, xgboost, e1071 and torch/keras.
queries: glmnet alpha lambda ranger randomForest mtry

leaves.leaf: Installation, startup configuration and package libraries
leaves.scope: Installing R and packages, startup files (Rprofile.site, .Rprofile, .Renviron), environment variables, options(), Rscript and R command-line flags, .libPaths and repositories, and project environments with renv and pak.

leaves.leaf: IDEs, debugging and profiling tools
leaves.scope: IDE features in RStudio, Positron and ESS, the debugging functions (browser, debug, debugonce, trace, traceback, recover), profiling (Rprof, profvis), benchmarking (bench, microbenchmark), and linting/formatting with lintr and styler.

leaves.leaf: History, governance and implementations of R
leaves.scope: R's origins in S at Bell Labs and with Ihaka and Gentleman in Auckland, the R Core Team, R Foundation and R Consortium, CRAN growth, useR! and The R Journal, the base and recommended package set, and alternative implementations and distributions (Renjin, FastR, pqR, TERR, Microsoft R Open, webR).
queries: Ross Ihaka Robert Gentleman Auckland S language
R Foundation R Core Team R Consortium
Microsoft R Open Revolution Analytics webR

leaves.leaf: Interoperability with other languages
leaves.scope: Bridges between R and other runtimes: reticulate (Python), rpy2, rJava, JuliaCall, V8 (JavaScript), Rserve, and type conversion between them.

leaves.leaf: HTTP, web APIs, JSON and web scraping
leaves.scope: HTTP requests with httr/httr2 and curl, JSON with jsonlite, XML/HTML parsing and scraping with xml2 and rvest, and building web APIs with plumber.

leaves.leaf: Built-in datasets package
leaves.scope: The datasets that ship with base R (iris, mtcars, airquality, ToothGrowth, Titanic, etc.): their dimensions, variables, units and original sources.

leaves.leaf: Language syntax: operators, precedence, reserved words and control flow
leaves.scope: The grammar of R as set out in the R Language Definition: operator precedence and associativity, reserved words, assignment operators, user-defined %op% infix operators, raw strings and backslash-lambda syntax, and how if/else, switch, for, while and repeat behave.
queries: R operator precedence Syntax help page
reserved words R if else repeat function
switch fall through R Language Definition
raw string literal backslash lambda syntax R

leaves.leaf: Optimization, root finding and numerical integration
leaves.scope: Numerical solvers in base R and contributed packages: optim methods (Nelder-Mead, BFGS, CG, L-BFGS-B, SANN, Brent), nlm, nlminb, optimize, uniroot, polyroot, integrate and constrOptim, plus optimx, nloptr and the deSolve ODE solvers.
queries: optim Nelder-Mead BFGS L-BFGS-B method control

leaves.leaf: Classical hypothesis tests, multiple comparisons and power analysis
leaves.scope: Inference functions in the stats package, such as t.test, wilcox.test, chisq.test, fisher.test, ks.test, shapiro.test, cor.test, p.adjust methods and power.t.test/power.prop.test, covering their default arguments and the htest objects they return.
queries: p.adjust holm hochberg BH BY methods

leaves.leaf: Bayesian modeling and MCMC interfaces
leaves.scope: R packages for Bayesian inference and MCMC sampling, including rstan, cmdstanr, brms, rstanarm, rjags/R2jags, nimble, MCMCpack, coda, bayesplot and loo, with their functions, sampler defaults, diagnostics and version history.
queries: rstan sampler warmup iter chains defaults

leaves.leaf: Survival analysis packages
leaves.scope: Time-to-event analysis in R: Surv objects, survfit, coxph tie-handling methods, survreg distributions and cox.zph from the survival package, plus extensions such as survminer, flexsurv, cmprsk and rms.
queries: Surv object coxph ties efron breslow

leaves.leaf: Reproducible environments and pipeline tools: renv, targets and rocker
leaves.scope: Tools for reproducible R projects: renv lockfiles, snapshot and restore, the earlier packrat and checkpoint, the targets and drake pipeline toolkits, dated Posit Package Manager snapshots and the Rocker Docker images.
queries: checkpoint packrat Posit Package Manager snapshot

leaves.leaf: Code style, linting and static code analysis
leaves.scope: R coding conventions and static tooling: the tidyverse and Google R style guides, lintr linters and .lintr configuration, the styler and Air formatters, codetools::checkUsage, and parse-data utilities such as getParseData.
